children: Intel shares rose about 2.5% in Tuesday premarket trading and nearly 3% in the morning, after dropping 28.6% Friday and 8.8% Monday on weak fourth-quarter guidance. Shares closed Monday at $59.97.
Intel (INTC) warned weak PC demand may persist through H1 2027 as rising memory costs lift PC prices and supply constraints hinder market recovery.
- Intel Corporation (INTC) signed a multiyear agreement with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure covering current and future Xeon processors, including the upcoming Diamond Rapids platform.
Barclays analyst Thomas O’Malley lowered Intel Corporation (INTC)’s price target to $75 from $100 and maintained an Equalweight rating.
New Street Research rated Intel (INTC) Buy with a $125 target, citing demand for server chips tied to businesses’ use of agentic AI. KGI and Evercore also held or raised positive ratings.
• Intel Corporation (INTC) is pursuing an acquisition of quantum software developer Classiq, while its Data Center and AI business recorded 78% growth.
- Intel Corporation (INTC) cited a temporary setback at its Kiryat Gat factory in Israel as a factor weighing on its outlook.
